snippet.title: Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
A world of quiet coves, tide worn villages and secrets the ocean refuses to give back....

Your father is missing, His diary is your only trail.

Explore, fight, farm, cook and weave magical staffs that burst with power

Wishlist on Steam 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4094850/Echoes_of_the_Cove/
